extraction_notes: The job identity was verified as frozen campaign order 929, LCSC C541711, MPN AONR21321, manufacturer Alpha Omega Semicon, family mosfet.
P-channel voltage and current numeric values are stored as magnitudes; signed source values and test conditions are retained in condition strings.
The Electrical Characteristics table states TJ = 25 °C unless otherwise noted. The RDS(on) row separately publishes TJ = 125 °C values for VGS = -10 V and ID = -12 A.

Figures 2, 5, and 6 explicitly identify 25 °C and 125 °C curves. Figures 1 and 3 do not state a curve temperature. Figure 7 states VDS and ID; Figure 8 does not state curve-specific bias, frequency, or temperature.
Curve points are conservative digitizations of visible plotted traces and grid locations only; no points were extrapolated beyond the displayed curves.
The body-diode field retains the published typical VSD value of -0.72 V as a magnitude; the separately published maximum -1 V value is not duplicated because the schema provides one body_diode slot.
